_about: research3 MT (docs/research3/MT-REPORT.md): f30_cluster scene textures, every measurement. bytes = one whole upload (what cluster-render charges to the KOMBI link's budget); pixel_memory = cluster-render's accounting (uncompressed twice, ETC2 once; 16 MiB for every app); frame_diff = the rendered 1920x720 frame of that state against today's, premultiplied colour and coverage in 0..255 (max, pixels over 2 / 8 / 16, PSNR and mean inside the sampling layers' box). Bench (Mac GPU, fp32) renders: what transfers to the car is bytes, pixel memory and the decoded texels; not milliseconds.
